EXPERIMENT: 1. Use browser_navigate to https://www.premierleague.com/en/tables/premier-league and wait for load.
2. Use capture_search_transactions to find a recorded request to https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v2/matches and inspect its query string for parameters controlling competition, season, and matchweek (e.g. compSeasId, gameweek, page, pageSize).
3. Then in the live browser, use browser_eval_js to call fetch() on the v2/matches URL using those parameters for competition 8 and season 2025 and a specific matchweek from the capture (e.g. 27 if present). Parse response.json().
4. If v2/matches is complex, also try the simpler v1 URL pattern /api/v1/competitions/8/seasons/2025/matchweeks/27/matches directly as seen in the capture.
5. Report: which URL pattern worked best, required query params, HTTP status, and a sample of top-level JSON keys.

Execute this experiment. Use capture_* tools for reference data and browser_* tools for live interaction. When done, call finalize_result with your findings.
